about: Public council development-application drawing sets for the local real-drawing suite (npm run test:council). Drawings are copyright of their authors and were published for public exhibition: fetch them into test/council/cache/ with scripts/fetch-council.mjs, never commit them. drawingPages are the sheets rendered and scanned (report/form pages are skipped); rotatedPages carry a /Rotate entry. encrypted marks edit-restricted sets (pdf2takeoff writes into those with an incremental update that keeps the original bytes and encryption). expect holds hand-checked facts: "length" = the distance between two points at the given scale must match a printed dimension; "count" = scanning from one instance must find this many. knownIssue marks an expectation the engine does not meet yet (reported as todo, not a failure).

sets.application: DA-2024-64, 183 Kregors Road, Gordon: dwelling and associated works
sets.notes: A3 sheets with all drawing text converted to outlines (no extractable scale text); raster logos in every title block; council stamp annotation on p1. Encrypted with no open password; AES-256 (V5/R6, AESV3 for strings and streams), linearized, objects in encrypted object streams; permissions (P -1052) allow annotating, so markups go in as an incremental update.
ArchiCAD (GSPublisher) A3 set with live text: 1:200 and 1:300 scale labels. pp1-3 are the council notice with 38 form-field annotations that a save must preserve.
